Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1What does 'Reach' primarily measure in social media analytics?
A. The total number of times your content was displayed.
B. The number of unique users who saw your content.
C. The number of likes and comments your post received.
D. The percentage of your followers who saw your content.
2Which content format on Instagram is best suited for quick, interactive polls or quizzes that disappear after 24 hours?
A. Instagram Feed Post
B. Instagram Reel
C. Instagram Story
D. IGTV Video
3When crafting a compelling social media caption, what is generally recommended regarding the placement of the Call-to-Action (CTA)?
A. Bury it at the very end of a long paragraph.
B. Place it prominently at the beginning or end of the caption, making it clear and concise.
C. Avoid using a CTA in most social media captions.
D. Only use emojis as a CTA.
4Which feature within Meta Business Suite is most useful for planning and visualizing your content schedule across Facebook and Instagram?
A. Inbox
B. Monetization
C. Content Planner/Calendar
D. Ads Manager
5If a user posts a highly negative but legitimate review on your client's Facebook page, what is the best initial course of action?
A. Delete the review immediately to protect the brand's image.
B. Publicly argue with the user to defend the brand's reputation.
C. Acknowledge the feedback publicly, apologize for their experience, and offer to resolve the issue via private message or email.
D. Ignore the review and hope it gets buried by other posts.
6For a B2C fashion brand targeting young adults, which platform is generally considered most visually-driven and effective for showcasing products through short videos and aspirational imagery?
A. LinkedIn
B. Facebook (primarily groups)
C. Instagram
D. Twitter (now X)
7What is a 'meme' in the context of social media content?
A. A long-form documentary about internet culture.
B. A type of sponsored advertisement.
C. An image, video, piece of text, etc., typically humorous in nature, that is copied and spread rapidly by internet users, often with slight variations.
D. A formal academic paper published online.
8Why is it important to use consistent profile pictures and cover photos across all social media platforms for a brand?
A. It allows you to use the same content on every platform without any changes.
B. It helps build a strong, recognizable brand identity and fosters trust and familiarity with the audience.
C. It reduces the need for any content planning.
D. It makes it harder for competitors to copy your strategy.
9If you need to quickly resize an image for different social media platforms without losing quality, which tool or feature would be most helpful?
A. A complex video editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro.
B. Canva's 'Magic Resize' feature or similar functionality in other online design tools.
C. A spreadsheet program like Microsoft Excel.
D. A word processing application like Google Docs.
10How can an AI-powered content generator assist a Social Media Executive in drafting captions?
A. By fully automating all creative processes without human input.
B. By generating complex video animations from scratch.
C. By providing initial caption drafts, suggesting different tones, or expanding on bullet points, which can then be refined by the executive.
D. By replacing the need for audience engagement.
11What is the main purpose of 'boosting' a Facebook post?
A. To automatically delete the post after 24 hours.
B. To increase the organic reach of the post to your existing followers only.
C. To pay to show your post to a wider, targeted audience beyond your existing followers.
D. To convert the post into a long-form article.
12Before publishing a carousel post with multiple images, what specific check is crucial for the visuals?
A. Ensure all images are exactly the same size and aspect ratio.
B. Verify the images are in the correct sequence and visually cohesive.
C. Check if the images contain hidden messages.
D. Make sure the images are compressed to the lowest possible quality.
13How can AI tools help in identifying trending hashtags for a specific campaign?
A. By physically creating new hashtags that don't exist.
B. By analyzing vast amounts of social media data to identify popular and relevant hashtags related to your content and industry.
C. By randomly generating a list of common words.
D. By only suggesting hashtags that are already overused.
14When analyzing a competitor's social media presence, what key aspect helps you understand their audience engagement strategy?
A. The number of employees they have.
B. The type of content that receives the most likes, comments, and shares, and how they respond to interactions.
C. Their annual revenue reports.
D. The physical location of their headquarters.
15What is a potential limitation of relying solely on AI for generating creative content ideas?
A. AI can generate too many ideas, making selection difficult.
B. AI may lack true human creativity, emotional intelligence, and understanding of nuanced cultural contexts, leading to generic or off-brand suggestions.
C. AI-generated ideas are always too complex to execute.
D. AI cannot generate ideas for visual content.

Section B — Short Answers

3 questions
B1Imagine you're managing social media for a local bookstore, 'Page Turners.' Propose three distinct content ideas for their Instagram feed, explaining how each would engage their audience (local book lovers) and promote reading.
B2A client expresses dissatisfaction, stating, 'Our social media isn't generating enough leads.' How would you respond to this, and what steps would you take to address their concern, given your role as a Social Media Executive?
B3Describe your step-by-step process for planning and organizing content for a full week across Instagram and Facebook, specifically mentioning how you would use a content calendar and Meta Business Suite to ensure timely and consistent posting.

Section C — Long Answer

1 question(s)
C1D'Genius Solutions has secured 'GreenHarvest,' an organic food delivery service targeting busy urban professionals. Develop a 3-month social media strategy for GreenHarvest across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Your strategy should focus on building brand trust, showcasing product freshness, and driving subscriptions. Detail content pillars, specific content formats for each platform, suggested posting frequency, and key engagement tactics. Crucially, explain how you would leverage basic AI tools (e.g., for content ideas, caption drafts, trend analysis, image optimization suggestions) to enhance this strategy.
Minimum 150 words.

This role focuses on crafting premium jewellery visuals, AI-generated campaign creatives, motion graphic videos, and digital content for a high-end brand, ensuring meticulous attention to detail and brand consistency.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1Which of these AI tools is primarily known for its advanced capabilities in generating video from text or images?
A. Midjourney
B. RunwayML
C. Adobe Photoshop
D. Leonardo AI
2In Adobe After Effects, what is the primary function of a 'pre-composition'?
A. To export a final video file.
B. To group layers and nest them into a single, editable composition.
C. To apply a single effect to multiple individual layers.
D. To convert a raster image into a vector graphic.
3When designing for a luxury jewellery brand, which typography characteristic is generally preferred?
A. Bold, condensed, and highly decorative fonts.
B. Handwritten, informal, and playful fonts.
C. Clean, elegant, often sans-serif or classic serif fonts with generous leading and kerning.
D. Distorted, pixelated, or grunge-style fonts.
4What is the main advantage of using Adobe Illustrator over Photoshop for creating a brand logo?
A. Illustrator offers more advanced photo manipulation features.
B. Illustrator creates vector graphics that are infinitely scalable without loss of quality.
C. Illustrator is better for complex video editing tasks.
D. Illustrator has a simpler interface for beginners.
5To achieve a realistic 'sparkle effect' on a diamond in a motion graphic, which technique is most commonly used?
A. Applying a simple blur filter.
B. Using a particle generator or lens flare effects, often combined with masks and keyframes.
C. Reducing the overall brightness of the diamond.
D. Converting the diamond to a monochrome color.
6When using AI to generate 'jewellery-on-model' creatives, what is a crucial step to ensure the jewellery appears naturally integrated?
A. Ensuring the model is smiling broadly.
B. Ignoring the model's existing lighting and adding new, artificial light to the jewellery.
C. Carefully matching the light source, shadows, and color temperature of the jewellery to the model's environment.
D. Using only black and white images for the model.
7Which of these is NOT a common characteristic of premium jewellery photography/videography?
A. Sharp focus on intricate details and facets.
B. Soft, diffused lighting that enhances shine without harsh reflections.
C. Busy backgrounds that distract from the product.
D. Accurate representation of metal and gemstone colors.
8What is the primary purpose of 'color grading' in video editing for a luxury brand?
A. To make the video black and white.
B. To correct technical camera errors only.
C. To establish a consistent mood, aesthetic, and brand identity across all visuals.
D. To add distracting visual effects.
9Which AI tool is known for its user-friendly interface and ability to generate diverse images from text prompts, similar to Midjourney?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Leonardo AI
C. CapCut
D. Figma
10When creating a social media reel, what aspect ratio is most commonly used and optimized for vertical viewing?
A. 16:9 (widescreen)
B. 4:3 (standard TV)
C. 1:1 (square)
D. 9:16 (vertical)
11What is 'kerning' in typography?
A. The space between lines of text.
B. The overall spacing between all characters in a block of text.
C. The adjustment of space between individual letter pairs to improve visual appeal.
D. The size of the font.
12Which Adobe tool would you primarily use for advanced photo retouching and compositing of static jewellery images?
A. Adobe Illustrator
B. Adobe After Effects
C. Adobe Photoshop
D. Adobe Premiere Pro
13What is a key consideration when designing digital ads for a premium jewellery brand to avoid looking cheap?
A. Using bright, neon colors and flashing animations.
B. Overcrowding the ad with multiple products and excessive text.
C. Employing a clean layout, high-quality imagery, and a sophisticated call-to-action.
D. Using low-resolution images to save on loading time.
14Which of these AI tools is specifically mentioned for its capability in generating images from text prompts, often used for initial concept art?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Pika Labs
C. Midjourney
D. CapCut
15When creating motion graphics for a luxury product launch, what kind of transitions would be most appropriate?
A. Abrupt cuts and jarring wipes.
B. Fast, energetic, and bouncy transitions.
C. Smooth, elegant fades, subtle pushes, or sophisticated reveals.
D. Random, chaotic transitions with glitch effects.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1Which Adobe Creative Cloud application is primarily used for vector-based graphic design and illustration?
A. Adobe Photoshop
B. Adobe After Effects
C. Adobe Illustrator
D. Adobe Premiere Pro
2When generating images with AI tools like Midjourney or Leonardo AI, what does 'prompt engineering' refer to?
A. The process of training the AI model from scratch.
B. Writing descriptive text inputs (prompts) to guide the AI in generating specific visuals.
C. Editing the AI-generated images using Photoshop.
D. Troubleshooting errors in the AI generation software.
3In motion graphics, what is the primary purpose of easing (e.g., ease-in, ease-out)?
A. To make animations appear more robotic and mechanical.
B. To create smoother, more natural, and visually appealing movement by controlling the acceleration and deceleration of objects.
C. To increase the file size of the final video.
D. To add complex visual effects like blurs and glows.
4Which of the following is a key characteristic of vector graphics compared to raster graphics?
A. They are made up of pixels and lose quality when scaled up.
B. They are based on mathematical equations and can be scaled infinitely without losing quality.
C. They are ideal for photographic images.
D. They have larger file sizes.
5When editing a video for social media, what is generally considered the most important factor for viewer retention?
A. The length of the video.
B. The complexity of the visual effects.
C. The pacing and engagement within the first few seconds.
D. The number of different fonts used.
6Which AI tool is specifically designed for generating and editing video content from text prompts or existing images?
A. Midjourney
B. Adobe Photoshop
C. Runway / Kling AI / Pika Labs
D. Adobe Illustrator
7What does 'typography' refer to in graphic design?
A. The arrangement of visual elements in a design.
B. The art and technique of arranging typefaces (fonts) to make written language legible, readable, and appealing when displayed.
C. The use of color palettes in a design.
D. The process of creating 3D models.
8When converting AI-generated images into animated videos, what is a common challenge?
A. The AI images are too high resolution.
B. Achieving consistent motion and avoiding unnatural artifacts or 'flickering' between frames.
C. The AI images are always perfectly composed.
D. The AI tools automatically add sound effects.
9Which tool is commonly used for collaborative design and prototyping, often integrated into design workflows?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Canva
C. Figma
D. Adobe After Effects
10What is the primary function of Adobe After Effects?
A. Creating vector illustrations.
B. Editing raw video footage.
C. Compositing, animation, and creating motion graphics and visual effects.
D. Designing static social media posts.
11When designing for digital ads, what is a crucial element to consider for effective performance?
A. Using the maximum number of colors allowed.
B. A clear call-to-action (CTA) and a strong visual hook.
C. Making the ad as large as possible.
D. Including extensive background music.
12What does 'composition' refer to in visual design?
A. The choice of color palette.
B. The arrangement and relationship of visual elements within a frame or space.
C. The speed of animation.
D. The type of font used.
13Which of these AI tools is primarily known for generating realistic or stylized images from text descriptions?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Runway
C. Midjourney / Leonardo AI
D. CapCut
14For creating short, engaging videos like Instagram Reels, what is a key editing technique to maintain viewer interest?
A. Long, continuous shots with minimal cuts.
B. Fast-paced editing with frequent cuts, dynamic transitions, and engaging visuals/text overlays.
C. Using only background music without any sound effects.
D. Keeping the aspect ratio very wide.
15What is the main advantage of using AI tools like Adobe Firefly or Midjourney for concept generation?
A. They eliminate the need for any human creativity.
B. They can quickly generate a wide variety of visual ideas and styles based on prompts, accelerating the ideation process.
C. They always produce final, polished assets ready for publication.
D. They are only useful for creating abstract art.

3 questions
B1Describe your workflow when tasked with creating a social media reel using AI-generated elements.
B2How do you ensure brand consistency when creating creatives for different clients with distinct brand identities?
B3What is your approach to balancing creative experimentation with client/project objectives?

Describe in detail your creative process, including how you would leverage AI tools, what design principles you would focus on, and how you would ensure the content is engaging and aligns with the brand's sustainable message.           field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
          field.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function validateField(field) {
    if (!field || field.disabled || field.type === "hidden") return true;
    clearError(field);

    var value = String(field.value || "").trim();
    var required = field.hasAttribute("required") || field.getAttribute("aria-required") === "true";

    if (required && !value) {
      showError(field, "This field is required.");
      return false;
    }

    if ((field.type === "email" || /email/i.test(field.name || "")) && value) {
      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value)) {
        showError(field, "Please enter a valid email address.");
        return false;
      }
    }

    if ((field.type === "tel" || /phone|mobile|whatsapp/i.test(field.name || "")) && value) {
      var digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");
      if (digits.length < 10) {
        showError(field, "Please enter a valid phone number.");
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  function getRequirementField(form) {
    return form.querySelector('textarea[name*="requirement" i], textarea[name*="message" i], textarea[name*="business" i], textarea, input[name*="requirement" i], input[name*="message" i], input[name*="business" i]');
  }

  function normalisePhone(form) {
    var phone = form.querySelector('input[type="tel"], input[name*="phone" i], input[name*="mobile" i]');
    if (!phone) return;
    var digits = String(phone.value || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (digits.length === 10) phone.value = "+91" + digits;
    else if (digits.length === 12 && digits.indexOf("91") === 0) phone.value = "+" + digits;
    phone.setAttribute("value", phone.value);
  }

  function containsBlockedIntent(form) {
    var text = Array.prototype.map.call(
      form.querySelectorAll('textarea, input[type="text"], input[type="search"]'),
      function (el) {
        var name = String(el.name || "").toLowerCase();
        if (/email|phone|mobile|website|company|url|consent|confirmation/.test(name)) return "";
        return String(el.value || "").toLowerCase();
      }
    ).join(" ");

    var patterns = [
      /\bjob\s+application\b/i,
      /\blooking\s+for\s+(a\s+)?job\b/i,
      /\bwant\s+(a\s+)?job\b/i,
      /\bneed\s+(a\s+)?job\b/i,
      /\bapplying\s+for\s+(a\s+)?job\b/i,
      /\binternship\b/i,
      /\bfreelancer\s+(pitch|profile|proposal|request)\b/i,
      /\bfreelance\s+(work|project|proposal|profile)\b/i,
      /\bresume\b/i,
      /\bcv\b/i,
      /\bwork\s+from\s+home\b/i,
      /\bvacancy\b/i
    ];

    return patterns.some(function (pattern) { return pattern.test(text); });
  }

  function prepareForm(form) {
    if (!form) return;

    setFormField(form, ["service_name", "hidden_service_name", "service", "hidden_1"], "Website Development", true);
    setFormField(form, ["lead_source", "hidden_lead_source"], "Google Ads Landing Page", true);
    setFormField(form, ["landing_page_url", "page_url"], window.location.href, true);
    setFormField(form, ["referrer_url", "referrer"], document.referrer || "Direct Visit", true);

    ["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_term", "utm_content", "gclid", "gbraid", "wbraid", "campaignid", "adgroupid", "creative", "matchtype", "device"].forEach(function (name) {
      setFormField(form, [name], getParam(name), true);
    });

    var submit = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"], .ff-btn-submit');
    if (submit) {
      if ("value" in submit) submit.value = "Share My Website Requirement";
      submit.textContent = "Share My Website Requirement";
    }

    var phone = form.querySelector('input[type="tel"], input[name*="phone" i], input[name*="mobile" i]');
    if (phone && !phone.dataset.dgsReady) {
      phone.dataset.dgsReady = "1";
      phone.setAttribute("placeholder", "+91 98765 43210");
      phone.addEventListener("blur", function () { normalisePhone(form); });
    }

    if (form.dataset.dgsReady) return;
    form.dataset.dgsReady = "1";

    form.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea").forEach(function (field) {
      field.addEventListener("blur", function () { validateField(field); });
      field.addEventListener("input", function () {
        var group = closestGroup(field);
        if (group && group.classList.contains("dgs-field-error")) validateField(field);
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
      var valid = true;
      form.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea").forEach(function (field) {
        if (!validateField(field)) valid = false;
      });

      var requirement = getRequirementField(form);
      if (requirement) {
        var requirementValue = String(requirement.value || "").trim();
        if (!requirementValue) {
          showError(requirement, "Please share your business website requirement.");
          valid = false;
        } else if (requirementValue.length < 12) {
          showError(requirement, "Please add a little more detail about the website requirement.");
          valid = false;
        }
      }

      if (containsBlockedIntent(form)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (typeof event.stopImmediatePropagation === "function") event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if (requirement) {
          showError(requirement, "This form is for business website enquiries only. Job, internship and freelancer requests are not accepted here.");
          requirement.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          requirement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        }
        pushDataLayer("dgs_form_blocked_intent", { form_name: "website_development" });
        return false;
      }

      normalisePhone(form);

      if (!valid) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var firstError = form.querySelector(".dgs-field-error input, .dgs-field-error select, .dgs-field-error textarea");
        if (firstError) {
          firstError.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          firstError.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        }
        return false;
      }

      pushDataLayer("dgs_lead_form_attempt", { form_name: "website_development", lead_source: "google_ads_landing_page" });
    }, true);
  }

  function enhanceForms() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById(FORM_WRAP_ID);
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(prepareForm);
  }

  function restoreCaseImages() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-web-case-media img").forEach(function (img) {
      var src = img.getAttribute("src") || img.getAttribute("data-src") || img.getAttribute("data-lazy-src") || "";
      if (!src || src.indexOf("{{") === 0) return;
      img.setAttribute("src", src);
      img.setAttribute("loading", "eager");
      img.setAttribute("decoding", "async");
      img.setAttribute("data-no-lazy", "1");
      img.setAttribute("data-skip-lazy", "1");
      img.classList.add("skip-lazy", "no-lazy", "dgs-web-case-img");
      img.style.display = "block";
      img.style.visibility = "visible";
      img.style.opacity = "1";
    });
  }

  function initFaq() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-web-faq-q").forEach(function (button) {
      if (button.dataset.dgsReady) return;
      button.dataset.dgsReady = "1";
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var item = button.closest(".dgs-web-faq-item");
        if (!item) return;
        var open = !item.classList.contains("active");
        item.classList.toggle("active", open);
        button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
        var icon = button.querySelector("i");
        if (icon) icon.textContent = open ? "−" : "+";
      });
    });
  }

  function initCtas() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dgs-web-ads-page a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (link) {
      if (link.dataset.dgsSmooth) return;
      link.dataset.dgsSmooth = "1";
      link.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        var selector = link.getAttribute("href");
        var target = selector ? document.querySelector(selector) : null;
        if (target) {
          event.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        }
        pushDataLayer("dgs_landing_cta_click", { cta_name: link.getAttribute("data-dgs-cta") || link.textContent.trim() });
      });
    });
  }

  function watchFormSuccess() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById(FORM_WRAP_ID);
    if (!wrap || wrap.dataset.dgsSuccessWatch) return;
    wrap.dataset.dgsSuccessWatch = "1";

    var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (SUCCESS_EVENT_SENT) return;
      var success = wrap.querySelector(".ff-message-success, .ff-el-is-success, .fluentform .ff-message-success");
      if (success && String(success.textContent || "").trim()) {
        SUCCESS_EVENT_SENT = true;
        pushDataLayer("dgs_lead_form_success", { form_name: "website_development", lead_source: "google_ads_landing_page" });
      }
    });

    observer.observe(wrap, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
  }

  function boot() {
    initFaq();
    initCtas();
    enhanceForms();
    restoreCaseImages();
    watchFormSuccess();
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  window.addEventListener("load", boot);
  [500, 1200, 2400, 4000].forEach(function (delay) { setTimeout(boot, delay); });
})();

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  if (window.__DGS_AI_TOOLTIP_ERRORS_ONLY__) return;
  window.__DGS_AI_TOOLTIP_ERRORS_ONLY__ = true;

  function closestGroup(el) {
    return el ? el.closest(".ff-el-group, .ff-t-cell, .ff-el-input--content") : null;
  }

  function removeCustomError(group) {
    if (!group) return;
    group.classList.remove("dgs-field-error");
    var msg = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (msg) msg.remove();
  }

  function addCustomError(input, message) {
    var group = closestGroup(input);
    if (!group) return;
    group.classList.add("dgs-field-error");

    var existing = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (!existing) {
      existing = document.createElement("span");
      existing.className = "dgs-field-error-message";
      group.appendChild(existing);
    }
    existing.textContent = message || "Please enter a valid value.";
  }

  function validateSingleInput(input) {
    if (!input || input.type === "hidden" || input.disabled) return true;

    var group = closestGroup(input);
    removeCustomError(group);

    var value = String(input.value || "").trim();
    var required = input.hasAttribute("required") || input.getAttribute("aria-required") === "true";

    if (required && !value) {
      addCustomError(input, "This field is required.");
      return false;
    }

    if (input.type === "email" && value) {
      var emailOk = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
      if (!emailOk) {
        addCustomError(input, "Please enter a valid business email address.");
        return false;
      }

      var domain = value.toLowerCase().split("@").pop();
      var blockedDomains = [
        "gmail.com","yahoo.com","yahoo.co.in","hotmail.com","outlook.com","msn.com","icloud.com",
        "rediffmail.com","aol.com","proton.me","protonmail.com","live.com","mail.com","zoho.com",
        "yandex.com","gmx.com","fastmail.com"
      ];

      if (blockedDomains.indexOf(domain) > -1) {
        addCustomError(input, "Please use your business email address.");
        return false;
      }
    }

    if ((input.type === "tel" || /phone|mobile|whatsapp/i.test(input.name || "")) && value) {
      var digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");
      if (digits.length < 10) {
        addCustomError(input, "Please enter a valid work phone number.");
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  function watchForm(form) {
    if (!form || form.dataset.dgsTooltipValidationReady) return;
    form.dataset.dgsTooltipValidationReady = "1";

    form.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea").forEach(function(input){
      input.addEventListener("blur", function(){
        validateSingleInput(input);
      });

      input.addEventListener("input", function(){
        var group = closestGroup(input);
        if (group && group.classList.contains("dgs-field-error")) {
          validateSingleInput(input);
        }
      });

      input.addEventListener("change", function(){
        var group = closestGroup(input);
        if (group && group.classList.contains("dgs-field-error")) {
          validateSingleInput(input);
        }
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
      var ok = true;
      form.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea").forEach(function(input){
        if (!validateSingleInput(input)) ok = false;
      });

      var firstError = form.querySelector(".dgs-field-error input, .dgs-field-error select, .dgs-field-error textarea");
      if (!ok && firstError) {
        e.preventDefault();
        firstError.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        firstError.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        return false;
      }
    }, true);
  }

  function init() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById("dgs-ai-production-lead-form");
    if (!wrap) return;

    wrap.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(watchForm);

    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(){
      wrap.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(watchForm);
    });

    observer.observe(wrap, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  setTimeout(init, 800);
  setTimeout(init, 1800);
})();
</script>

  ];

  function closestGroup(el) {

  function clearError(field) {
    var group = closestGroup(field);
    if (!group) return;

    group.classList.remove("dgs-field-error");

    var existing = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (existing) existing.remove();

  function showError(field, message) {
    var group = closestGroup(field);
    if (!group) return;

    group.classList.add("dgs-field-error");

    var existing = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (!existing) {
      existing = document.createElement("span");
      existing.className = "dgs-field-error-message";
      group.appendChild(existing);
    }

    existing.textContent = message;
  }

  function hardStop(e, field, message) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    if (typeof e.stopImmediatePropagation === "function") {
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }

    showError(field, message);

    );
  }

  function validateEmailField(e, form) {
    var emailField = getEmailField(form);
    if (!emailField) return true;

    clearError(emailField);

    var email = String(emailField.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!email) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please enter your official business email address.");
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please enter a valid business email address.");
    }

    var domain = email.split("@").pop();

    if (blockedDomains.indexOf(domain) > -1) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please use your official business email address. Personal email IDs like Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, Hotmail, iCloud and Rediffmail are not accepted.");

    if (!requirementField) return true;

    clearError(requirementField);

    var value = String(requirementField.value || "").trim();

    if (!value) {
      return hardStop(e, requirementField, "Please share your AI video production requirement.");
    }

    if (value.length < 8) {
      return hardStop(e, requirementField, "Please add a little more detail about your AI video production requirement.");
    }

    return true;
  }

    var form = e.target;

    if (!form || !form.closest("#dgs-ai-production-lead-form")) return;

    if (!validateEmailField(e, form)) return false;

  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.dgs-seo-ads-page a {
  color: inherit !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.dgs-seo-ads-page img {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.dgs-seo-wrap {
  width: min(1500px, calc(100% - 40px)) !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
}

.dgs-grad-text {
  background: var(--dgs-gradient) !important;
  background-size: 220% 220% !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
  background-clip: text !important;
  color: transparent !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
}

.dgs-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 9px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  color: var(--dgs-orange) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(232,97,42,0.24) !important;
  background: rgba(232,97,42,0.055) !important;
  padding: 8px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  margin-bottom: 20px !important;
}

.dgs-eyebrow:before {
  content: "" !important;
  width: 7px !important;
  height: 7px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--dgs-orange) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232,97,42,0.52) !important;
}

.dgs-section {
  padding: 82px 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  position: relative !important;
}

.dgs-section-soft {
  background: var(--dgs-bg-soft) !important;
}

.dgs-section-head {
  text-align: center !important;
  max-width: 860px !important;
  margin: 0 auto 46px !important;
}

.dgs-section-head h2 {
  font-family: "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 58px) !important;
  font-weight: 850 !important;
  line-height: 1.05 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.055em !important;
  color: var(--dgs-text) !important;
  margin: 0 0 14px !important;
}

.dgs-section-head p {
  color: var(--dgs-muted) !important;
  font-size: 16.5px !important;
  line-height: 1.75 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.dgs-divider {
  width: 70px !important;
  height: 2px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: var(--dgs-gradient) !important;
  margin: 22px auto 0 !important;
}

.dgs-btn {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  min-height: 54px !important;
  padding: 15px 24px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  font-family: "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 850 !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
  transition: 0.28s ease !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
}

.dgs-btn-primary {
  background: var(--dgs-gradient) !important;
  background-image: var(--dgs-gradient) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(196,63,122,0.26) !important;
}

.dgs-btn-primary:hover {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(196,63,122,0.36) !important;
}

.dgs-btn-ghost {
  color: var(--dgs-text) !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  border-color: var(--dgs-line) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(20,17,31,0.06) !important;
}

.dgs-btn-ghost:hover {
  color: var(--dgs-orange) !important;
  border-color: rgba(232,97,42,0.46) !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
}

.dgs-hero {
  padding: 54px 0 46px !important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 14%, rgba(232,97,42,0.10), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 5%, rgba(98,71,176,0.11), transparent 36%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, var(--dgs-bg) 100%) !important;
}

.dgs-hero-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.02fr) minmax(520px, 0.98fr) !important;
  gap: 48px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

.dgs-hero-copy {
  padding-top: 18px !important;
}

.dgs-hero h1 {
  font-family: "Manrope", Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 4.15vw, 64px) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;

}

}

.dgs-hero-actions {
  display: flex !important;

  gap: 14px !important;
  margin: 0 0 28px !important;
}

.dgs-proof-row {

  gap: 12px !important;

}

.dgs-proof-card {

.dgs-hero-value-panel {
  margin-top: 18px !important;
  max-width: 760px !important;

  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.74) !important;

}

  display: block !important;

  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 950 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}

.dgs-hero-value-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
}

.dgs-hero-value-item {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
  padding: 12px !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(20,17,31,0.08) !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
}

.dgs-hero-value-item b {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 24px !important;
  height: 24px !important;

}

.dgs-hero-value-item span {

.dgs-hero-bottom-note {

.dgs-form-card {

.dgs-form-slot {

<script>
(function () {
  var scrollPos = 0;

  function openModal(id) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("modal-" + id);
    if (!modal) return;

    scrollPos = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    document.body.style.position = "fixed";
    document.body.style.top = "-" + scrollPos + "px";
    document.body.style.width = "100%";
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    modal.classList.add("active");
  }

  function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-modal-overlay.active").forEach(function (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove("active");
    });

    document.body.style.position = "";
    document.body.style.top = "";
    document.body.style.width = "";
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
  }

  var proofLightboxState = {
    filter: "all",
    index: 0,
    items: []
  };

  function getProofCards(filter) {
    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-live-proof-card"));
    return cards.filter(function (card) {
      var category = card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "";
      return filter === "all" || category === filter;
    }).map(function (card) {
      var img = card.querySelector("img");
      var tag = card.querySelector(".dgs-live-proof-tag");
      var title = card.querySelector(".dgs-live-proof-title");
      return {
        href: card.getAttribute("href") || (img ? img.getAttribute("src") : ""),
        alt: img ? img.getAttribute("alt") || "Search proof screenshot" : "Search proof screenshot",
        tag: tag ? tag.textContent.trim() : "SEO Proof",
        title: title ? title.textContent.trim() : "Search visibility proof",
        category: card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "all",
        element: card
      };
    });
  }

  function updateProofLightbox() {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal || !proofLightboxState.items.length) return;

    var total = proofLightboxState.items.length;
    if (proofLightboxState.index < 0) proofLightboxState.index = total - 1;
    if (proofLightboxState.index >= total) proofLightboxState.index = 0;

    var item = proofLightboxState.items[proofLightboxState.index];
    var img = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-img]");
    var tag = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-tag]");
    var title = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-title]");
    var count = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-count]");

    if (img) {
      img.src = item.href;
      img.alt = item.alt;
    }

    if (tag) tag.textContent = item.tag;
    if (title) title.textContent = item.title;
    if (count) count.textContent = (proofLightboxState.index + 1) + " of " + total + " proof screenshots";

    modal.querySelectorAll(".dgs-proof-lightbox-tab.active").forEach(function (tab) {
      tab.classList.remove("active");
    });

    var activeTab = modal.querySelector('[data-proof-lightbox-filter="' + proofLightboxState.filter + '"]');
    if (activeTab) activeTab.classList.add("active");
  }

  function openProofLightbox(card) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal) return;

    var currentPageTab = document.querySelector("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-proof-tab.active");
    proofLightboxState.filter = currentPageTab ? currentPageTab.getAttribute("data-proof-filter") || "all" : "all";
    proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);

    var clickedIndex = proofLightboxState.items.findIndex(function (item) {
      return item.element === card;
    });

    if (clickedIndex < 0) {
      proofLightboxState.filter = card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "all";
      proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);
      clickedIndex = proofLightboxState.items.findIndex(function (item) {
        return item.element === card;
      });
    }

    proofLightboxState.index = clickedIndex >= 0 ? clickedIndex : 0;

    scrollPos = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    document.body.style.position = "fixed";
    document.body.style.top = "-" + scrollPos + "px";
    document.body.style.width = "100%";
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    modal.classList.add("active");
    modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    updateProofLightbox();
  }

  function closeProofLightbox() {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal || !modal.classList.contains("active")) return;

    modal.classList.remove("active");
    modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

    document.body.style.position = "";
    document.body.style.top = "";
    document.body.style.width = "";
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
  }

  function initPageInteractions() {
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var proofCardClick = e.target.closest("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-live-proof-card");
      if (proofCardClick) {
        e.preventDefault();
        openProofLightbox(proofCardClick);
        return;
      }

      var proofLightboxClose = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-close]");
      if (proofLightboxClose) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofLightboxOverlay = e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains("dgs-proof-lightbox");
      if (proofLightboxOverlay) {
        closeProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofPrev = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-prev]");
      if (proofPrev) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.index -= 1;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofNext = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-next]");
      if (proofNext) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.index += 1;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofLightboxTab = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-filter]");
      if (proofLightboxTab) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.filter = proofLightboxTab.getAttribute("data-proof-lightbox-filter") || "all";
        proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);
        proofLightboxState.index = 0;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var card = e.target.closest("[data-modal]");
      if (card) {
        openModal(card.getAttribute("data-modal"));
        return;
      }

      var closeBtn = e.target.closest("[data-close]");
      if (closeBtn) {
        closeAllModals();
        return;
      }

      if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains("dgs-modal-overlay")) {
        closeAllModals();
        return;
      }

      var faqBtn = e.target.closest(".dgs-faq-q");
      if (faqBtn) {
        var item = faqBtn.closest(".dgs-faq-item");
        var isActive = item.classList.contains("active");

        document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-faq-item.active").forEach(function (openItem) {
          openItem.classList.remove("active");
        });

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
        return;
      }


      var proofTab = e.target.closest(".dgs-proof-tab");
      if (proofTab) {
        e.preventDefault();

        var proofSection = proofTab.closest("#dgs-live-search-proof");
        if (!proofSection) return;

        var filter = proofTab.getAttribute("data-proof-filter") || "all";
        var label = proofTab.textContent.trim();
        var cards = proofSection.querySelectorAll(".dgs-live-proof-card");
        var visibleCount = 0;

        proofSection.querySelectorAll(".dgs-proof-tab.active").forEach(function (tab) {
          tab.classList.remove("active");
        });

        proofTab.classList.add("active");

        cards.forEach(function (proofCard) {
          var category = proofCard.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "";
          var shouldShow = filter === "all" || category === filter;

          proofCard.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !shouldShow);

          if (shouldShow) visibleCount++;
        });

        var countLabel = proofSection.querySelector("[data-proof-count]");
        if (countLabel) {
          countLabel.textContent = filter === "all"
            ? "Showing all search proof screenshots"
            : "Showing " + visibleCount + " " + label + " proof screenshot" + (visibleCount === 1 ? "" : "s");
        }

        return;
      }

      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot input[name="work_phone"]'
    ));
  }

  function cleanIndianPhone(value) {
    var raw = String(value || '').trim();
    raw = raw.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');

    if (!raw || raw === '+') return '';

    if (raw.indexOf('+') === 0) {
      return '+' + raw.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    }

    raw = raw.replace(/^0+/, '');

    if (raw.indexOf('91') === 0 && raw.length >= 12) {
      return '+' + raw;
    }

    return '+91' + raw;
  }

  function preparePhoneInput(input) {
    if (!input || input.dataset.dgsPhoneReady === 'yes') return;
    input.dataset.dgsPhoneReady = 'yes';

    input.setAttribute('placeholder', '+91 98765 43210');
    input.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'tel');
    input.setAttribute('inputmode', 'tel');

    input.addEventListener('focus', function () {
      if (!input.value.trim()) {
        input.value = '+91 ';
        setTimeout(function () {
          try { input.setSelectionRange(input.value.length, input.value.length); } catch (e) {}
        }, 0);
      }
    });

    input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
      var digits = input.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if (digits.length > 2) {
        input.value = cleanIndianPhone(input.value);
      }
    });
  }

  function normalizePhonesBeforeSubmit(form) {
    getPhoneInputs().forEach(function (input) {
      var digits = input.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

      }
    });

    setServiceSubmitText();
    getPhoneInputs().forEach(preparePhoneInput);

    document.querySelectorAll('.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot form').forEach(function (form) {
      if (form.dataset.dgsPhoneSubmitReady === 'yes') return;

<script>
(function () {
  var scrollPos = 0;

  function openModal(id) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("modal-" + id);
    if (!modal) return;

    scrollPos = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    document.body.style.position = "fixed";
    document.body.style.top = "-" + scrollPos + "px";
    document.body.style.width = "100%";
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    modal.classList.add("active");
  }

  function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-modal-overlay.active").forEach(function (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove("active");
    });

    document.body.style.position = "";
    document.body.style.top = "";
    document.body.style.width = "";
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
  }

  var proofLightboxState = {
    filter: "all",
    index: 0,
    items: []
  };

  function getProofCards(filter) {
    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-live-proof-card"));
    return cards.filter(function (card) {
      var category = card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "";
      return filter === "all" || category === filter;
    }).map(function (card) {
      var img = card.querySelector("img");
      var tag = card.querySelector(".dgs-live-proof-tag");
      var title = card.querySelector(".dgs-live-proof-title");
      return {
        href: card.getAttribute("href") || (img ? img.getAttribute("src") : ""),
        alt: img ? img.getAttribute("alt") || "Search proof screenshot" : "Search proof screenshot",
        tag: tag ? tag.textContent.trim() : "SEO Proof",
        title: title ? title.textContent.trim() : "Search visibility proof",
        category: card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "all",
        element: card
      };
    });
  }

  function updateProofLightbox() {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal || !proofLightboxState.items.length) return;

    var total = proofLightboxState.items.length;
    if (proofLightboxState.index < 0) proofLightboxState.index = total - 1;
    if (proofLightboxState.index >= total) proofLightboxState.index = 0;

    var item = proofLightboxState.items[proofLightboxState.index];
    var img = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-img]");
    var tag = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-tag]");
    var title = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-title]");
    var count = modal.querySelector("[data-proof-lightbox-count]");

    if (img) {
      img.src = item.href;
      img.alt = item.alt;
    }

    if (tag) tag.textContent = item.tag;
    if (title) title.textContent = item.title;
    if (count) count.textContent = (proofLightboxState.index + 1) + " of " + total + " proof screenshots";

    modal.querySelectorAll(".dgs-proof-lightbox-tab.active").forEach(function (tab) {
      tab.classList.remove("active");
    });

    var activeTab = modal.querySelector('[data-proof-lightbox-filter="' + proofLightboxState.filter + '"]');
    if (activeTab) activeTab.classList.add("active");
  }

  function openProofLightbox(card) {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal) return;

    var currentPageTab = document.querySelector("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-proof-tab.active");
    proofLightboxState.filter = currentPageTab ? currentPageTab.getAttribute("data-proof-filter") || "all" : "all";
    proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);

    var clickedIndex = proofLightboxState.items.findIndex(function (item) {
      return item.element === card;
    });

    if (clickedIndex < 0) {
      proofLightboxState.filter = card.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "all";
      proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);
      clickedIndex = proofLightboxState.items.findIndex(function (item) {
        return item.element === card;
      });
    }

    proofLightboxState.index = clickedIndex >= 0 ? clickedIndex : 0;

    scrollPos = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    document.body.style.position = "fixed";
    document.body.style.top = "-" + scrollPos + "px";
    document.body.style.width = "100%";
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    modal.classList.add("active");
    modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    updateProofLightbox();
  }

  function closeProofLightbox() {
    var modal = document.getElementById("dgs-proof-lightbox");
    if (!modal || !modal.classList.contains("active")) return;

    modal.classList.remove("active");
    modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

    document.body.style.position = "";
    document.body.style.top = "";
    document.body.style.width = "";
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
    window.scrollTo(0, scrollPos);
  }

  function initPageInteractions() {
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var proofCardClick = e.target.closest("#dgs-live-search-proof .dgs-live-proof-card");
      if (proofCardClick) {

        openProofLightbox(proofCardClick);
        return;

      var proofLightboxClose = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-close]");
      if (proofLightboxClose) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeProofLightbox();

      if (proofLightboxOverlay) {
        closeProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofPrev = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-prev]");
      if (proofPrev) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.index -= 1;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofNext = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-next]");
      if (proofNext) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.index += 1;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var proofLightboxTab = e.target.closest("[data-proof-lightbox-filter]");
      if (proofLightboxTab) {
        e.preventDefault();
        proofLightboxState.filter = proofLightboxTab.getAttribute("data-proof-lightbox-filter") || "all";
        proofLightboxState.items = getProofCards(proofLightboxState.filter);
        proofLightboxState.index = 0;
        updateProofLightbox();
        return;
      }

      var card = e.target.closest("[data-modal]");
      if (card) {
        openModal(card.getAttribute("data-modal"));
        return;
      }

      var closeBtn = e.target.closest("[data-close]");
      if (closeBtn) {
        closeAllModals();
        return;
      }

      if (e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains("dgs-modal-overlay")) {
        closeAllModals();
        return;
      }

      var faqBtn = e.target.closest(".dgs-faq-q");
      if (faqBtn) {
        var item = faqBtn.closest(".dgs-faq-item");
        var isActive = item.classList.contains("active");

        document.querySelectorAll(".dgs-faq-item.active").forEach(function (openItem) {
          openItem.classList.remove("active");
        });

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
        return;
      }


      var proofTab = e.target.closest(".dgs-proof-tab");
      if (proofTab) {
        e.preventDefault();

        var proofSection = proofTab.closest("#dgs-live-search-proof");
        if (!proofSection) return;

        var filter = proofTab.getAttribute("data-proof-filter") || "all";
        var label = proofTab.textContent.trim();
        var cards = proofSection.querySelectorAll(".dgs-live-proof-card");
        var visibleCount = 0;

        proofSection.querySelectorAll(".dgs-proof-tab.active").forEach(function (tab) {
          tab.classList.remove("active");
        });

        proofTab.classList.add("active");

        cards.forEach(function (proofCard) {
          var category = proofCard.getAttribute("data-proof-category") || "";
          var shouldShow = filter === "all" || category === filter;

          proofCard.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !shouldShow);

          if (shouldShow) visibleCount++;
        });

        var countLabel = proofSection.querySelector("[data-proof-count]");
        if (countLabel) {
          countLabel.textContent = filter === "all"
            ? "Showing all search proof screenshots"
            : "Showing " + visibleCount + " " + label + " proof screenshot" + (visibleCount === 1 ? "" : "s");
        }

        return;
      }

      var anchor = e.target.closest('.dgs-seo-ads-page a[href^="#"], .dgs-mobile-sticky-cta[href^="#"]');

  ];

  function getParam(name) {
    return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get(name) || "";
  }

  function saveTrackingParams() {
    trackingParams.forEach(function (name) {
      var value = getParam(name);
      if (value) sessionStorage.setItem("dgs_" + name, value);
    });

  function findFieldsByName(form, name) {
    return form.querySelectorAll(
      'input[name="' + name + '"], textarea[name="' + name + '"], select[name="' + name + '"], ' +
      'input[name="form_fields[' + name + ']"], textarea[name="form_fields[' + name + ']"], select[name="form_fields[' + name + ']"]'
    );
  }

  function setFormField(form, names, value) {
    if (!value) return;
    names.forEach(function (name) {
      findFieldsByName(form, name).forEach(function (field) {
        field.value = value;
        field.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
      });
    });
  }

  function fillTrackingFields(form) {
    trackingParams.forEach(function (name) {
      var value = getParam(name) || sessionStorage.getItem("dgs_" + name) || "";
      setFormField(form, [name], value);
    });

    setFormField(form, ["landing_page_url", "landing_page"], window.location.href);
    setFormField(form, ["referrer_url", "referrer"], document.referrer);
    setFormField(form, ["service_name"], "SEO Services");
    setFormField(form, ["lead_source"], "Google Ads Landing Page");
  }

  function getEmailDomain(email) {
    var clean = String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean.indexOf("@") === -1) return "";
    return clean.split("@").pop();
  }

  function hasBlockedIntent(value) {
    var text = String(value || "").toLowerCase();
    return blockedIntentWords.some(function (word) {
      return text.indexOf(word) !== -1;
    });
  }

  function clearError(field) {
    if (!field) return;
    field.setCustomValidity("");
    var wrap = field.closest(".ff-el-group, .forminator-field, .dgs-form-slot") || field.parentElement;
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.querySelectorAll(".dgs-custom-form-error").forEach(function (el) { el.remove(); });
    wrap.classList.remove("dgs-has-error");
  }

  function showError(field, message) {
    if (!field) return;
    clearError(field);
    field.setCustomValidity(message);
    var wrap = field.closest(".ff-el-group, .forminator-field, .dgs-form-slot") || field.parentElement;
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.classList.add("dgs-has-error");

    error.style.cssText = "margin-top:6px;color:#c43f7a;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:700;";
    error.textContent = message;
    wrap.appendChild(error);
  }

  function validateLeadForm(form) {
    var valid = true;
    var email = form.querySelector('input[name="email"], input[type="email"]');
    var message = form.querySelector('textarea[name="requirement"], textarea');

    if (email) {
      var domain = getEmailDomain(email.value);
      if (blockedDomains.indexOf(domain) !== -1) {
        showError(email, "Use your company email. Free personal email addresses are not accepted.");
        valid = false;
      } else {
        clearError(email);
      }
    }

    if (message) {
      if (hasBlockedIntent(message.value)) {
        showError(message, "This form is only for business SEO enquiries. Job, internship, freelancer and training requests are not accepted here.");
        valid = false;
      } else {
        clearError(message);
      }
    }

    return valid;
  }

  function initForms() {
    saveTrackingParams();

    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form");
    forms.forEach(function (form) {
      if (!form.closest("#dgs-seo-lead-form")) return;

      fillTrackingFields(form);

      var email = form.querySelector('input[name="email"], input[type="email"]');
      var message = form.querySelector('textarea[name="requirement"], textarea');

      if (email && !email.dataset.dgsValidationAttached) {
        email.dataset.dgsValidationAttached = "1";
        email.addEventListener("blur", function () { validateLeadForm(form); });
        email.addEventListener("input", function () { clearError(email); });
      }

      if (message && !message.dataset.dgsValidationAttached) {
        message.dataset.dgsValidationAttached = "1";
        message.addEventListener("blur", function () { validateLeadForm(form); });
        message.addEventListener("input", function () { clearError(message); });
      }

      if (!form.dataset.dgsValidationAttached) {
        form.dataset.dgsValidationAttached = "1";
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
          fillTrackingFields(form);
          if (!validateLeadForm(form)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            return false;
          }
        }, true);
      }
    });
  }

  function boot() {
    initPageInteractions();
    initForms();
    setTimeout(initForms, 800);
    setTimeout(initForms, 1800);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  function getPhoneInputs() {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot .ff-el-phone input[type="tel"], ' +
      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot .iti input[type="tel"], ' +
      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot input[type="tel"], ' +
      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot input[name="phone"], ' +
      '.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot input[name="work_phone"]'
    ));
  }

  function cleanIndianPhone(value) {
    var raw = String(value || '').trim();
    raw = raw.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');

    if (!raw || raw === '+') return '';

    if (raw.indexOf('+') === 0) {
      return '+' + raw.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    }

    raw = raw.replace(/^0+/, '');

    if (raw.indexOf('91') === 0 && raw.length >= 12) {
      return '+' + raw;
    }

    return '+91' + raw;
  }

  function preparePhoneInput(input) {
    if (!input || input.dataset.dgsPhoneReady === 'yes') return;
    input.dataset.dgsPhoneReady = 'yes';

    input.setAttribute('placeholder', '+91 98765 43210');
    input.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'tel');
    input.setAttribute('inputmode', 'tel');

    input.addEventListener('focus', function () {
      if (!input.value.trim()) {
        input.value = '+91 ';
        setTimeout(function () {
          try { input.setSelectionRange(input.value.length, input.value.length); } catch (e) {}
        }, 0);
      }
    });

    input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
      var digits = input.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if (digits.length > 2) {
        input.value = cleanIndianPhone(input.value);
      }
    });
  }

  function normalizePhonesBeforeSubmit(form) {
    getPhoneInputs().forEach(function (input) {
      var digits = input.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if (digits.length > 2) {
        input.value = cleanIndianPhone(input.value);
      }
    });
  }

  function setServiceSubmitText() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot button[type="submit"], .dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot input[type="submit"], .dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot .ff-btn-submit').forEach(function (btn) {
      if (btn.tagName && btn.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'input') {
        btn.value = 'Request SEO Growth Consultation';
      } else {
        btn.textContent = 'Request SEO Growth Consultation';
      }
    });
  }

  function bootPhoneFix() {
    setServiceSubmitText();
    getPhoneInputs().forEach(preparePhoneInput);

    document.querySelectorAll('.dgs-seo-ads-page .dgs-form-slot form').forEach(function (form) {
      if (form.dataset.dgsPhoneSubmitReady === 'yes') return;
      form.dataset.dgsPhoneSubmitReady = 'yes';
      form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
        normalizePhonesBeforeSubmit(form);
      }, true);

      form.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (event.target.closest('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"], .ff-btn-submit')) {
          normalizePhonesBeforeSubmit(form);
        }
      }, true);
    });
  }

  bootPhoneFix();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootPhoneFix);
  window.addEventListener('load', bootPhoneFix);

  var attempts = 0;
  var timer = setInterval(function () {
    bootPhoneFix();
    attempts += 1;
    if (attempts >= 25) clearInterval(timer);
  }, 300);
})();
</script>

  function clearError(field) {
    var group = closestGroup(field);
    if (!group) return;

    group.classList.remove("dgs-field-error");

    var existing = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (existing) existing.remove();
  }

  function showError(field, message) {
    var group = closestGroup(field);
    if (!group) return;

    group.classList.add("dgs-field-error");

    var existing = group.querySelector(".dgs-field-error-message");
    if (!existing) {
      existing = document.createElement("span");
      existing.className = "dgs-field-error-message";
      group.appendChild(existing);
    }

    existing.textContent = message;
  }

  function hardStop(e, field, message) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    if (typeof e.stopImmediatePropagation === "function") {
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }

    showError(field, message);

    field.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    field.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });

    return false;
  }

  function getEmailField(form) {

    clearError(emailField);

    if (!email) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please enter your official business email address.");
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please enter a valid business email address.");
    }

    var domain = email.split("@").pop();

    if (blockedDomains.indexOf(domain) > -1) {
      return hardStop(e, emailField, "Please use your official business email address. Personal email IDs like Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, Hotmail, iCloud and Rediffmail are not accepted.");
    }

    return true;
  }

  function validateRequirementField(e, form) {
    var requirementField = getRequirementField(form);
    if (!requirementField) return true;

    clearError(requirementField);

    var value = String(requirementField.value || "").trim();

    if (!value) {
      return hardStop(e, requirementField, "Please share your AI video production requirement.");
    }

    if (value.length < 8) {
      return hardStop(e, requirementField, "Please add a little more detail about your AI video production requirement.");
    }

    return true;
  }

    var form = e.target;

    if (!form || !form.closest("#dgs-ai-production-lead-form")) return;

    if (!validateEmailField(e, form)) return false;
    if (!validateRequirementField(e, form)) return false;

  }, true);

.p .recth { display:inline-block; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 16px; border-radius:100px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A); color:#fff; margin-bottom:10px; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(196,63,122,.4); }

.p .tdg { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(232,97,42,.07),rgba(196,63,122,.05)) !important; border-left:1px solid rgba(232,97,42,.18) !important; border-right:1px solid rgba(196,63,122,.18) !important; }
.p .ty  { color:#22C55E; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; }

.p .tgr { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; }

.p .trg td { background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(232,97,42,.055),rgba(98,71,176,.03)) !important; padding:10px 24px !important; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12) !important; }

.p .pil  { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:300; display:block; margin-top:4px; }

/* Clients */

/* ── NEWS MARQUEE ── */
.p .mqwrap { position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:8px 0; -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,black 10%,black 90%,transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,black 10%,black 90%,transparent); }

.p .nc img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; opacity:.72; transition:opacity .28s; }
.p .nc:hover img { opacity:1; }

/* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */
.p .tg2 { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:18px; }
.p .tc { background:var(--bg2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:30px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; transition:border-color .2s; }

.p .tcnm { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--silver); display:block; }
.p .tcrl { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:300; display:block; margin-top:1px; }
.p .tcco { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; display:block; margin-top:2px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; }

/* ── FAQ — full !important override against theme ── */
.p .fq { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line) !important; background:transparent !important; }
.p .fqbtn { width:100% !important; display:flex !important; justify-content:space-between !important; align-items:center !important; padding:21px 0 !important; cursor:pointer !important; gap:16px !important; background:none !important; background-color:transparent !important; background-image:none !important; border:none !important; border-bottom:none !important; text-align:left !important; outline:none !important; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif !important; box-shadow:none !important; border-radius:0 !important; margin:0 !important; }
.p .fqbtn:focus { outline:none !important; box-shadow:none !important; }
.p .fqbtn:hover { background:none !important; background-color:transparent !important; }
.p .fqbtn:hover .fqq { color:var(--silver) !important; }
.p .fqq { font-size:16px !important; font-weight:500 !important; color:var(--body) !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--body) !important; transition:color .2s !important; flex:1 !important; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif !important; }
.p .fqic { width:26px !important; height:26px !important; border-radius:50% !important; border:1px solid var(--ln2) !important; display:flex !important; align-items:center !important; justify-content:center !important; flex-shrink:0 !important; font-size:16px !important; color:var(--muted) !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--muted) !important; transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s !important; background:transparent !important; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif !important; }

.p .fqa { font-size:14.5px !important; color:var(--muted) !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--muted) !important; line-height:1.78 !important; font-weight:300 !important; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif !important; }
.p .fqa strong { color:var(--body) !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--body) !important; font-weight:500 !important; }

/* ── ENTERPRISE ── */
.p .enqbox { border:1px solid rgba(196,63,122,.22); border-radius:22px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(232,97,42,.04),rgba(196,63,122,.035) 55%,rgba(98,71,176,.03)); padding:64px 56px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
.p .enqbox::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:2px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; }
.p .enqin { display:grid; grid-template-columns:400px 1fr; gap:60px; align-items:start; }

.p .arr { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; font-weight:700; }
.p .fp { background:var(--bg2); border:1px solid var(--ln2); border-radius:14px; padding:36px 38px; }
.p .fptitle { font-size:18px; font-weight:600; color:var(--silver); margin-bottom:24px; text-align:center; }
.p .frow { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; }
.p .fg { margin-bottom:12px; }

.p .fg input,.p .fg select,.p .fg textarea { width:100%; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--ln2); border-radius:8px; color:var(--silver); font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:300; outline:none; transition:border-color .2s; -webkit-appearance:none; }

.p .commit { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:12px; color:var(--body); background:rgba(245,158,11,.07); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.16); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 14px; margin-bottom:14px; font-weight:300; }
.p .commit strong { color:#FCD34D; font-weight:600; }
.p .subbtn,.p button.subbtn { display:block !important; width:100% !important; padding:15px !important; border:none !important; border-radius:9px !important; background:#E8612A !important; background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A) !important; background-color:#E8612A !important; color:#fff !important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#fff !important; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif !important; font-size:14px !important; font-weight:600 !important; letter-spacing:.06em !important; text-transform:uppercase !important; cursor:pointer !important; transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s !important; -webkit-appearance:none !important; appearance:none !important; }
.p .subbtn::before,.p .subbtn::after { display:none !important; content:none !important; background:none !important; }
.p .subbtn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px) !important; box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(196,63,122,.38) !important; }
.p .fpnote { font-size:11px; color:var(--dim); text-align:center; margin-top:11px; font-weight:300; }

/* ── MODALS ── */
.p .modal { position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(3,2,9,.92); backdrop-filter:blur(22px); z-index:9999; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px; opacity:0; visibility:hidden; transition:opacity .3s,visibility .3s; }
.p .modal.on { opacity:1; visibility:visible; }
.p .mbox { background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--ln2); border-radius:18px; max-width:640px; width:100%; max-height:88vh; overflow-y:auto; position:relative; box-shadow:0 48px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.8); transform:translateY(20px) scale(.97); transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); }
.p .modal.on .mbox { transform:translateY(0) scale(1); }
.p .mbox::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:2px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; border-radius:18px 18px 0 0; }
.p .mbox::-webkit-scrollbar { width:3px; }
.p .mbox::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:rgba(196,63,122,.3); border-radius:2px; }
.p .mh { padding:24px 56px 20px 26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); position:sticky; top:0; background:rgba(20,17,34,.97); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); z-index:10; }
.p .mx { position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); border:1px solid var(--ln2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; font-size:15px; color:var(--muted); transition:all .2s; }
.p .mx:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.12); color:var(--silver); }
.p .mind { font-size:9px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:4px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; display:block; }
.p .mtitle { font-size:20px; font-weight:600; color:var(--silver); margin-bottom:2px; display:block; }
.p .msub { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:300; display:block; }
.p .mb { padding:24px 26px 32px; }
.p .mimg { height:176px; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom:22px; }
.p .mimg img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:top; }
.p .ms { margin-bottom:20px; }
.p .mst { font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:12px; padding-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; display:block; }
.p .mmet { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:9px; }
.p .mm { background:rgba(232,97,42,.06); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:13px; text-align:center; }
.p .mm strong { display:block; font-size:26px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.5px; line-height:1; margin-bottom:3px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8612A,#C43F7A,#6247B0,#C43F7A,#E8612A); background-size:300% 300%; -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:gs 5s ease infinite; }
.p .mm span { font-size:9.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.1em; }
.p .mlist { list-style:none; }
.p .mlist li { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; padding:9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04); font-size:14px; color:var(--body); font-weight:300; }
.p .mlist li:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.p .mlc { width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:2px; background:rgba(34,197,94,.1); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:9px; color:#22C55E; }
.p .mdesc { font-size:14px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.78; padding:14px 16px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); border-radius:8px; border-left:2px solid rgba(196,63,122,.5); font-weight:300; }
.p .ffph { border:1px dashed var(--ln2); border-radius:9px; padding:28px; text-align:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.02); }
.p .ffph p { font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; font-weight:300; }
.p .ffph code { font-size:13px; color:#F09060; background:rgba(232,97,42,.09); padding:4px 10px; border-radius:5px; }

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:1200px) {
  .p .pgrid { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr) !important; }
  .p .pc.ch { transform:none !important; }
  .p .pc.ch:hover { transform:translateY(-6px) !important; }
  .p .proc { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) !important; gap:28px !important; }
  .p .proc::before { display:none !important; }
  .p .hlg { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) !important; }
  .p .enqin { grid-template-columns:1fr !important; }
}
@media(max-width:860px) {
  .p .pgrid { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important; }
  .p .csg,.p .tg2 { grid-template-columns:1fr !important; }
  .p .hlg { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important; }
  .p .bento-row { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important; }
  .p .cmp-mobile { display:none !important; }
